scientific_integrity: The probability identities are proved for all finite fields; enumeration over small prime fields is only corroboration. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No evaluation is claimed for arbitrary finite nonsemisimple rings. The general proof uses the classical Artin–Wedderburn structure theorem and a self-contained count of nilpotent finite-field matrices. An equivalent claim in unindexed matrix-product literature remains possible.
title: Rectangular nilpotent-product law over finite fields and its semisimple-ring consequence
